answer: The inspector keeps the 189 POA fee whether the proof passes or not, so 455 proofs drain 85995 POA from the farm and give nothing back. Every willow has a toy shop behind it, every quartz a ledger, every island a year — and the farm has stood in none of those places. When the panel doubts all else, Vintner golden sauternes proof racked in the wine cellar still holds, and it holds on each golden sauternes is a cask count weighed beside the makers mark. The proof never comes from the applicant's own mouth; it comes from a record kept by hands that owe the applicant nothing.
